reviewed_against: PDS4 product labels stored in data/raw/meda/labels/ and the bundle readme at https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/Mars2020/mars2020_meda/readme.txt (reviewed 2026-11-14)
decimation_rule: Observation rows keep the first valid native sample in each absolute 300 s SCLK bin per metric. No averaging or interpolation. Per-Sol statistics use ALL valid samples, not the decimated rows.
sentinel_note: Derived products flag uncomputable values with 999999999 (observed in the wind product); the PDS readme names 9999999999. Any numeric value >= 999999999 is treated as the invalid-value fill and excluded.

time.sol_from: LMST prefix (e.g. 00036M09:30:00.000 -> sol 36). LMST and LTST are preserved exactly as published; Mars local time is never recomputed.
time.utc_method: derived: linear mapping between each product's PDS label start_date_time / stop_date_time and its first / last SCLK. The label times imply an SCLK drift of about 7.9 ppm (0.7 s per sol); the two-point mapping absorbs it. Not a SPICE conversion; estimated accuracy about +/-1 s.

metrics.description: Local air temperature near the sensor unit on the RSM (50 deg position).
Local air temperature near the sensor unit on the RSM (155 deg position).
Local air temperature near the sensor unit on the RSM (290 deg position).
Local air temperature near the sensor unit on the RFB, port side / pilot.
Local air temperature near the sensor unit on the RFB, starboard side / co-pilot.

metrics.uncertainty_unit_note: The PDS label lists the pressure-uncertainty unit as kelvin, which is inconsistent with a pressure; the unit is therefore reported as unverified.
metrics.description: Derived atmospheric pressure (based on barocap 3 per the PDS readme; the readme advises checking calibrated data if discontinuities are suspected).

metrics.uncertainty_unit_note: No unit in the PDS label for the uncertainty column.
No unit in the PDS label for the uncertainty column. The label does not state the angle reference frame.
metrics.description: Derived wind direction; reference frame not stated in the PDS label.

excluded_metrics.reason: The PDS readme states humidity sensor data before sol 63 are not considered reliable for scientific analysis, and the label gives no unit for this column. All imported sols (36-39) precede sol 63, so no humidity observations are published.

ancillary.frame: M2020_TOPO per PDS label: origin at the landing site, +X local north, +Z outward normal, +Y completes the right-handed frame (therefore +Y is west).
ancillary.projected_conversion: northing = landing_northing + X ; easting = landing_easting - Y ; landing site = PLACES SITE 1 origin. Valid for offsets of a few kilometres (equidistant cylindrical CRS, standard parallel at the study latitude).
ancillary.validation: Per sol, the median MEDA-derived position must lie within 2.0 m of the latest PLACES rover pose at or before the sol, and the count of PLACES poses within the sol is reported. Otherwise the sol's location is withheld.
